preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly 2n - 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= 10**6 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ai, bi, ci) has nodes ai and bi between 1 and n inclusive, and weight ci between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(bi == 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:])
preconditions.description: The last n - 1 edges all end at node 1.
The number of queries is exactly q.

preconditions.expression: all(query[0] in [1, 2] for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is of type 1 or type 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= 2 * n - 2 and 1 <= w <= 10**6 for query in queries if query[0] == 1 for i, w in [query[1:]] * (query[0] == 1))
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, the edge index i is between 1 and 2n - 2 inclusive, and the new weight w is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for query in queries if query[0] == 2 for u, v in [query[1:]] * (query[0] == 2))
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, the nodes u and v are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a type 2 query is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= 10**6 * (n - 1) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a type 2 query is between 0 and 1,000,000 * (n - 1) inclusive.

postconditions.expression: results == [shortest_path_length(graph, u, v) for query in queries if query[0] == 2 for u, v in [query[1:]] * (query[0] == 2)]
postconditions.description: Each result for a type 2 query is the shortest path length between nodes u and v in the current graph.
